summary: Expanded the node from obvious grid/EPC names into a narrow transmission-hardware and adjacent-structures universe. The strongest underfollowed candidate is PLPC because it is closest to clamps, formed wire, conductor accessories, string hardware, and utility line components that must be procured before transmission construction revenue appears at EPCs.
